slides.title: Welcome to Fruit Stand 🍎
slides.text: You and a partner run fruit stands. Most money at the end wins.

slides.title: Your fruit
slides.text: You get one fruit and keep it all game. One other player sells the same fruit: your rival. Your partner sells a different fruit.

slides.title: Set your price
slides.text: Each round, secretly pick $1–$5 on your phone and press Submit. You have 5 minutes. No pick = $5.

slides.title: Cheapest wins
slides.text: The lowest price sells ALL of that fruit. Ties split.

slides.title: Talk, deal, betray
slides.text: Find your rival, make deals… or break them. Results show only each fruit's lowest price, never who set it.

slides.title: Change token 🔄
slides.text: Once per game, switch to another fruit before you submit. Everyone is told.

slides.title: Partners
slides.text: Rounds 1–2 with one partner, rounds 3–4 with a new one. Your score = half of each team's earnings.

slides.title: Winning 🏆
slides.text: Nobody sees totals until the end. Final standings are revealed after round 4.

secretIntro.title: 🙈 Secret Market!
secretIntro.text: These fruits' prices stay hidden until the end — even from their sellers.
